lines: (Miss Marigold looks up from a very big book.)
Oh, hello! Welcome to Lantern Hill Library. I'm Miss Marigold, the librarian. We whisper in here, but only a little.
Perfect whisper. You'll fit right in.
I like to read by the pond after work. The ducks don't mind, as long as I read the good bits out loud.
Kip's helping in the library this afternoon. He's put all the books in order. By colour. I'll fix it tomorrow.

rotate: Looking for something? Mysteries are on the left, adventures on the right, and the books about the old oak are... hm. Someone's borrowed them all again.
There's a book here, older than the town, that says the oak was planted 'where the two clocks meet'. I've no idea what it means. Do you?
Please return your books on time. Mrs. Wren once returned one forty years late. She paid the fine in pennies. All of them.
Reading tip: if a book's a little bit scary, read it with a friend. If it's very scary, read it with Barnaby. He sings the scary bits away.
